notes.title: Grim Diary: ReWrite (Big Changes)
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/e508fdb9a2eaca89a2983083f7e2aaf357a79161.png"]

This is a revision of the project grim diary. The last patch has been a while because of the big changes still in development. The project has not been abandoned, it’s constantly being developed. It’s a big step~up and changes compared to the previous direction.




No More Modes 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/a6149d759a604cb2b53b89637ddba1f91b04b215.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/83a93a1cdefd4a049a6819ef4fb9344e49b2ccca.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/0810a7f4de00c0dd01c0c24a69d6d08590348c67.png"]Instead of modes it will be added as part of the world going to explore. Everything now revolve around exploring.All the modes now will be added in this new open world. 




Changes to Character Selection
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/daa166887a68f16ef71d0f6febff785567bdd0d3.png"]

Instead of the character selection player will be modifying the team through the world itself.

New additional characters will be recruitable to the party. Default characters will be Emi and Eli.


Defeat Condition


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/0e73d3d9e14c518f85ad2b2addcd7423a533f1a0.png"]

Will spawn to Save Point which can be found inside the kabo’s Village.


Battle/Encounter
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/1403b473d28758687705a12bd8558f6f6ce8738b.png"]

The battle system does not change much.











[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/d5a86d8dd371756bf6a807debbec45a0c6af9919.png"]

Thank you for the support.





If you’re interested to see the constant update and behind the scenes.

Fast Forward Feature

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/b7b6bfebb262be85ecb284cb5dac49af093ff7de.png"]

Toggle ~ Clicking the UI Change the phase permanently

Hold Space or Hold Mouse right button ~ Temporary fast forward.

 
This feature is added for more control and enhances experience by being able to do strategies better and make the phasing much faster.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/13efc29ae976f237c1576dad88a0c713e6c47870.png"]

Hand Limit

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/60aa654133ea0e1d91d67cda8bddefbca65fdf49.png"]



Hand limit is not indicated before and leads to confusing gameplay.

Now it’s set to Maximum of 6 cards on hand.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/13efc29ae976f237c1576dad88a0c713e6c47870.png"]

-Remove the default 50% Action meter at the start of the encounter.

-Remove Extra Draw after shuffling

notes.title: 0.01v New Patch Update
notes.notes:
Removing Priority Effect Replace by Rebounder



Rebounder

A player can choose passives to their liking. As the name implies, for every passive activate it will affect other stats of the character. Starting the journey with the unique items with these rebound effects.
